item.title: Tassel 1.6.2
item.description: Google Docs keep their formatting: syllabus tables and headings show the way the teacher made them. Your school Google accounts now sign back in by themselves through your school's sign-in (pictures included), and signing in to Canvas connects your school Google account right away. Super Intelligence (and other AI apps connected to Tassel) can now open what's in your modules: pages, files and discussions. Updates now install automatically by default.

item.title: Tassel 1.6.1
item.description: Fixes: signing back in to your school in the background no longer pops up the sign-in window when it actually worked. On the Grades tab, a click shows an assignment in the details panel and a double-click opens it, and more StudentVUE grades are linked to their Canvas assignments. Action buttons in the details panel have room and wrap instead of squeezing.

item.title: Tassel 1.6
item.description: A new setup that does the work for you: sign in to your school's Canvas once, and Tassel connects your school's Google account and StudentVUE with that same sign-in wherever it can. Add a second Canvas (like a college) or skip it. If StudentVUE wasn't found, a ZIP code finds your district (your school's is picked for you) with your username and password already filled in; any Google account that didn't connect is one click. Everything can be skipped and changed later in Settings.

item.title: Tassel 1.5
item.description: Stay signed in without thinking about it: sign in once in Tassel and it remembers your school sign-in (username, password, and the pictures for picture-password logins like RapidIdentity), then signs you back in by itself in the background whenever your school signs you out. The same sign-in keeps your school Google accounts connected (and adds them for your schools on its own) and fills in StudentVUE when you add it. Saved only on your Mac; it stops at any login error so it never locks your account.

item.title: Tassel 1.4
item.description: Grades, reimagined: every assignment shows your score as a percent and how much of your class grade it's worth, everywhere (lists, details, the Grades tab), with bars for what you kept and lost. Ungraded work shows what it will be worth without counting yet; work that's closed or a week late without being turned in counts as an estimated 0. Change an assignment's category or add your own, saved per class. The official grade sits next to Tassel's calculation. Super Intelligence: knows your Do First ranking, grades, schedule and attached files, answers in tidy sections, and shows what it's doing. Use Apple Intelligence (Local), Claude (Subscription), ChatGPT or Gemini with your own account (set up right in Tassel, no API key), or any API key, each with its choice of model. Connect Tassel to other AI apps (Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and more). Also: signed-in Canvas accounts stay signed in with an access token; scanned PDFs are read; documents get summaries; resolve messages and announcements without deleting them; StudentVUE zeros for work you've since turned in on Canvas no longer count.

item.title: Tassel 1.3
item.description: Today now puts what to do first at the top, ranked by how soon it's due, how much it's worth and how long it takes, with the few messages that really need you. One To Do list with All, Today, Upcoming, Missing, Important and Done. AI summaries of messages, announcements and assignments, with time and effort estimates. One search that works on the page you're on. Grades shown out of 100 with what each assignment is worth. Join Canvas classes you're invited to, keep your accounts in sync between Macs, course links on each class's home page, videos that open in Tassel, a cleaner sidebar and bigger text. Also fixes sign-ins that could be lost overnight.

item.title: Tassel 1.2
item.description: Tassel is now free for everyone, with Tassel Pro for invited students. New: assignment types you can filter and sort, one layout for assignments and messages, optional on-device summaries with an Action Needed list, and a week-long Pro trial.

item.title: Tassel 1.1
item.description: Sign-in fixes for schools with their own login pages, Important items, a better menu bar panel, Settings → Classes, automatic updates.
